metadata.description: FreeCode community skills, agents, hooks, rules, MCP conventions, and operator workflows

plugins.name: freecode-core
plugins.description: Core agents and skills for everyday development: architect, code review, refactoring, deep research, and git workflow. Enabled by default after marketplace install.

plugins.name: freecode-testing
plugins.description: TDD, end-to-end testing, evaluation harness, and verification agents and skills.

plugins.name: freecode-security
plugins.description: Security review, vulnerability scanning, HIPAA compliance, and safety guard agents and skills.

plugins.name: freecode-languages
plugins.description: Language-specific review agents and coding patterns for Python, Go, Rust, Java, TypeScript, React, Kotlin, C#, and Swift.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Lets FreeCode launch a real browser via the Playwright MCP server to navigate, screenshot, and interact with web pages — useful for verifying UI changes and fixing visual bugs.

plugins.name: agent-sdk-dev
plugins.description: FreeCode Agent SDK Development Plugin

plugins.name: code-modernization
plugins.description: Modernize legacy codebases (COBOL, legacy Java/C++, monolith web apps) with a structured preflight / assess / map / extract-rules / brief / reimagine / transform / harden workflow, an interactive topology viewer, and specialist review agents

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Agent that simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving functionality

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Streamline your git workflow with simple commands for committing, pushing, and creating pull requests

plugins.name: cwc-makers
plugins.description: Seamless onboarding for the Code-with-FreeCode Makers Cardputer: one /maker-setup command clones the build-with-freecode repo, flashes UIFlow firmware, and installs the FreeCode Buddy app bundle onto a freshly-plugged-in M5Stack Cardputer-Adv.

plugins.name: explanatory-output-style
plugins.description: Adds educational insights about implementation choices and codebase patterns (mimics the deprecated Explanatory output style)

plugins.name: persona-output-styles
plugins.description: Role-based output styles (frontend designer, devops engineer, data analyst, security auditor, project manager, video maker, and more) for switching FreeCode's persona and focus per session

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

plugins.name: freecode-code-setup
plugins.description: Analyze codebases and recommend tailored FreeCode Code automations such as hooks, skills, MCP servers, and subagents.

plugins.name: freecode-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve FREECODE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skill for UI/UX implementation

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Easily create hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns

plugins.name: learning-output-style
plugins.description: Interactive learning mode that requests meaningful code contributions at decision points (mimics the unshipped Learning output style)

plugins.name: math-olympiad
plugins.description: Solve competition math (IMO, Putnam, USAMO) with adversarial verification that catches what self-verification misses. Fresh-context verifiers attack proofs with specific failure patterns. Calibrated abstention over bluffing.

plugins.name: mcp-server-dev
plugins.description: Skills for designing and building MCP servers that work seamlessly with FreeCode — guides you through deployment models (remote HTTP, MCPB, local), tool design patterns, auth, and interactive MCP apps.

plugins.name: mcp-tunnels
plugins.description: Connect FreeCode to a private MCP server through an FreeCode MCP tunnel. Drives the Docker Compose quickstart end to end: certificates, proxy config, cloudflared, and a verifiable sample server.

plugins.name: playground
plugins.description: Creates interactive HTML playgrounds — self-contained single-file explorers with visual controls, live preview, and prompt output with copy button

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Plugin development toolkit with skills for creating agents, commands, hooks, MCP integrations, and comprehensive plugin structure guidance

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification

plugins.name: ralph-loop
plugins.description: Continuous self-referential AI loops for interactive iterative development, implementing the Ralph Wiggum technique. Run FreeCode in a while-true loop with the same prompt until task completion.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security review for freecode-generated code. Pattern-based warnings on edits, LLM-powered diff review on Stop, and an agentic commit reviewer that catches injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, and 25+ other vulnerability classes.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: session-report
plugins.description: Generate an explorable HTML report of FreeCode Code session usage — tokens, cache efficiency, subagents, skills, and the most expensive prompts — from local ~/.freecode/projects transcripts.

plugins.name: freecode-data-ml

plugins.name: freecode-healthcare
plugins.description: Healthcare-specific patterns, EMR/CDSS skills, and PHI compliance for clinical software.

plugins.name: freecode-business-ops
